label: Bringing actual good from every evil: DrawsGoodFrom g x y p means g actually brings the good of…
term: bringing actual good from every evil
definition: DrawsGoodFrom g x y p means g actually brings the good of perfection p in bearer y from the evil in x. The older distributive reading requires such a bearer and perfection for every x satisfying Evil. It is an interpretive strengthening relative to the collective scope, and does not require a different good for every evil or any outweighing benefit.
note: Parameter semantics for explicit scope comparison, motivated by the pinned ad 1 wording. A source argument fixing the relation extension or connecting the collective and distributive relations would be needed to go beyond this interpretation; no such bridge is supplied here.
